name: Cropit
tagline: Regenerative-farming insights with financing, pricing and spending analytics for farmers.

awards: Best Practical AI Innovation by Amazon

problem: Farmers lack accessible tools that connect regenerative practices to profit.
solution: A dashboard combining soil and market data with sustainability metrics, irrigation maps, loan applications and transaction analytics through financial APIs.
demo_moment: Team-described: open a field map and see recommendations with loan options.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Practical AI Innovation by Amazon” among 195 submissions.
Uses public USDA soil and market datasets.

lessons: Linking sustainability to profit widens the audience.
